projects.name: Voxel Portfolio
projects.tagline: Minecraft-themed dev portfolio with dual modes
projects.description: A high-performance interactive portfolio built using React, Three.js, and custom canvas loaders that dynamically shifts modes based on the viewer.
projects.challenges: Balancing Minecraft's voxel design language with responsive CSS layout parameters and rendering performance.

projects.name: PNG Chroma Remover
projects.description: A lightweight server utility that reads, parses, filters, and re-compresses raw PNG image byte buffers to replace chroma colors with alpha transparency.
projects.challenges: Reconstructing the Paeth and Sub PNG filters manually without external dependencies.

projects.name: LAN Audit Tool
projects.description: A rapid host discovery and open-port scanner utilizing concurrent execution structures to profile active local networks.
projects.challenges: Handling socket timeouts gracefully under high concurrency to avoid false-negative results.
